text: Core courses Introduction to Linguistics, Introduction to Teaching Chinese as a Second Language, Introduction to Chinese Culture, Modern Chinese, Ancient Chinese, English, Modern and Contemporary Chinese Literature, Ancient Chinese Literature, Foreign Literature, Introduction to European and American Culture Objective This objective is to train students to obtain the theory, knowledge and ability of Chinese language and culture, and have a good command of English language so that students, after graduation, are able to work at home and abroad teaching Chinese as a second language, or serve as professional applied-oriented personnel in the field of cultural exchanges with overseas countries. This undergraduate major falls into three aspects: literature, culture and language. Literature includes Chinese and foreign literature; culture includes Chinese and foreign culture; language includes Chinese and English. In addition, students are required to grasp the knowledge of the branches of linguistics Schooling Length In standards it lasts four years. The minimum of schooling length must be three years and its extension lasts no more than seven years. Credits The minimum of 175 credits must be obtained for graduation. Diploma Bachelor of Arts is granted
